query: The model is selected. Decide whether to use a bounded native subagent or create a persistent user-owned task for this review, and bind the worker's authority.
Delegation is settled and worker ownership is fixed. Select a supported model and effort for the assigned worker.
Send a status acknowledgment to the existing peer within its accepted assignment. No new execution or settings change is requested; the message schema has optional model and effort overrides.
Return this source-window readback to the existing peer in its accepted coordination assignment, calling it a continuation. Preserve its settings; no new execution is assigned.
A message called a quick update assigns new execution to an existing worker. Bind the new assignment scope, authority and handoff before selecting its model.
Bind the actual task handover and accepted restoration owner for overlapping scoped overrides; keep the queued future assignment from changing current work.
Send only a status acknowledgment inside the existing accepted peer assignment. An approved selection profile exists, but no execution or settings change is requested.
